zh.title: 美國航空班機乘客途中脫光衣服 抵達邁阿密後遭警方拘留
zh.summary: 美國航空乘客於途中脫光衣服；機組員執行安全程序；警方於邁阿密D2登機門將其拘留。
body: 根據航空新聞網站 Simple Flying 報導，美國航空一架空中巴士A319（ICAO機型代碼A319）客機於飛往邁阿密的航程中，發生一名乘客在機艙內脫光衣服的裸露事件。
在該起機上不當行為事件發生期間，班機機組人員立即採取並遵循相關航空安全程序進行處置。該架空中巴士A319客機於事件後繼續飛行，順利飛抵目的地的邁阿密機場。
當班機抵達邁阿密後，執法警察人員已於機場D2登機門預先戒備。警察隨後在客機靠泊D2登機門後，將該名涉事乘客當場拘留處置。

en.title: American Airlines Passenger Strips Mid-Flight And Is Detained By Police In Miami
en.summary: American Airlines passenger stripped naked mid-flight; crew followed security procedures; police detained passenger at Miami Gate D2.
body: According to reporting by Simple Flying, a passenger on board an American Airlines flight stripped naked mid-flight. The flight was operated with an Airbus A319 (ICAO type code A319) passenger aircraft.

Following the event in the cabin, the flight crew followed established security procedures to handle the situation during flight operations. The aircraft subsequently continued its journey toward Miami.

When the flight arrived in Miami, police officers responded at Gate D2. Law enforcement officials detained the passenger at Gate D2 after the aircraft completed its flight and reached the terminal gate.

zh.title: 西南航空擬斥資5300萬美元建設貴賓室網路
zh.summary: 西南航空規劃投入5300萬美元；於全美建置機場貴賓室網路
body: 根據 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 9 月 13 日的報導，美國低成本航空公司西南航空（Southwest Airlines）正在規劃建置全美機場貴賓室網路。相關資訊顯示，該航空公司計畫投入 5,300 萬美元用於建設機場貴賓室設施，儘管該公司目前並未營運頭等艙客艙。
西南航空此舉代表其在美國國內機場拓展旅客貴賓室基礎設施。報導摘要中尚未揭露具體貴賓室設置地點、預計開放時間表以及旅客進出貴賓室之適用資格等詳細營運細節。

en.title: Southwest Airlines Plans $53 Million Lounge Network Expansion Across US
en.summary: Southwest Airlines is spending $53 million to develop an airport lounge network across the United States.
body: Southwest Airlines is developing a network of airport lounges across the United States. According to news reporting published on September 13, 2026, by Simple Flying, the low-cost carrier is spending $53 million on a lounge project despite not operating a traditional first-class cabin to fund the amenity.

The development represents a notable expansion of passenger lounge facilities for the low-cost carrier as it builds out infrastructure across airports in the United States. Further operational details regarding specific airport locations, customer access eligibility criteria, and construction schedules were not provided in the preliminary summary report.
